description: Builds an itemized Holston AI quote from fixed prices: one-time builds, monthly plans, first-year total (monthly plans have a 12-month minimum), timeline, terms, fitting add-ons, and a shareable link to the quote on holstonai.com. Ask what the customer needs first; do not add plans they did not ask for.

assessment.description: Systems & Data Health Check, a one-time fixed-price assessment by company size: assessment-small (up to 50 employees) | assessment-medium (51–200) | assessment-large (201–500). The fee is credited toward a project started within 60 days.

builds.description: One-time builds. website-starter (one page, 3 days) | website-launch (up to 5 pages, 5 days) | website-growth (up to 10 pages, CMS, 10 days) | website-commerce (online store, 15–20 days) | small-app (custom web app, 2 weeks) | ai-agent-mvp (AI agent or SaaS MVP, 2–4 weeks).

business_name.description: Customer or business name to show on the quote.

care.description: Monthly service contract: care-site (websites) | care-app (apps and agents).

hosting.description: Monthly hosting: hosting-site (websites) | hosting-app (apps and agents).

seo_plan.description: Monthly SEO + AEO plan: seo-essentials (local) | seo-growth (adds AI search / AEO) | seo-authority (adds links, PR, competitor tracking).
